g.text: PayLink - Release Held Funds After a Failed Payment
This sequence is triggered internally only after the biller
failure is confirmed and Payment has entered Failed.
It releases the payment's Hold. The customer is notified;
this is not the optional FR-27 refund request for a Completed payment.
Stop. Do not release funds or change Payment status.
An Unknown payment must first be confirmed unsuccessful
1. Lock the Hold and verify its status.
2. If Active, post Debit Held + Credit Available.
3. Write one audit record for each ledger movement.
All changes commit together or roll back together.
[Hold already Released; matching release entries verified]
Recovery after a retry / partial application restart:
do not post another movement. Verify that this Hold's
matching release ledger entries already exist.
Do not release funds or mark Refunded.
Raise an inconsistency for support investigation.
Do not make a financial movement and do not mark
Payment as Refunded. Payment remains Failed.
Raise an operational alert for investigation.
